item.title: Spring fever takes a pause ahead of wet weather this weekend
item.description: A cold front broke the spring fever on Sunday, bringing cooler temperatures and bright skies, with a chance of showers returning Thursday and another storm system moving in Friday, followed by warmer temperatures and sunshine early next week.

item.title: City Council considering renaming of Springfield street
item.description: SPRINGFIELD. Mo. — Springfield City Council is considering a petition to rename Blaine Street, between Washington and Lyon Avenues. Requested and presented by the Commercial Club of Springfield, the street would be renamed to "Blaine Lane." If approved, the official map of the city would reflect the change. A vote is expected on Feb. 23.

item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Continued budget cuts are affecting Springfield Public Schools, with more positions being eliminated. item.title: A Lynching on the Square, The Staffords Remember What Springfield Forgot
item.description: Families in Springfield, Missouri are sharing stories of segregation, resilience, and community as Black History Month continues, including memories of a relative being lynched on the Springfield square and the challenges faced by the first Black mail carrier in the city.

item.title: Last week’s Springfield restaurant health code violations, Feb 2-6
item.description: Routine inspections of Springfield restaurants revealed a variety of health code violations, including improper food storage, unclean floors and equipment, and potentially hazardous food items not being held at the correct temperature, as well as an ice machine and light shield in disrepair.
